leads.title: The Parting
leads.author: black_and_noir
leads.description: A vast adventure through horror and hope
leads.pitch_sfx: His atmospheric and punchy sound design can create the deep, immersive, and tension-building audio crucial for a horror adventure, delivering both haunting ambience and impactful, physical SFX.
leads.pitch_music: His heavy, doom-infused music can perfectly complement the 'horror' aspect of the game, providing a brooding, intense, and argent metal soundscape that elevates the stakes.
leads.reason: The game's description as a 'vast adventure through horror and hope' directly aligns with the sound designer's ability to create both brooding, atmospheric horror and impactful, punchy effects, with a strong musical fit for the horror elements.

leads.title: Spectral Roots
leads.author: LaFilleDuCode
leads.description: A Game Boy narrative adventure. Explore an abandoned house and uncover the spectral truth of your past.
leads.pitch_sfx: His ability to craft immersive and haunting atmospheres could perfectly capture the spectral and unsettling feel of exploring an abandoned house, even within the Game Boy's technical limitations.
leads.pitch_music: While his heavy music style is a significant departure from typical Game Boy narrative adventure soundtracks, a minimalist, brooding ambient piece inspired by doom metal's texture could effectively underscore moments of dread or revelation.
leads.reason: The game's narrative focus and retro aesthetic present a challenge for the designer's heavy music and punchy SFX specialties, though atmospheric sound design remains a potential fit.
